definitions.gloss: applause and cheers; enthusiastic acclaim; thunderous ovation
definitions.explanation: The act of clapping hands and cheering loudly to show approval or admiration. Implies an enthusiastic, wholehearted response from an audience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The venue was filled with applause and cheers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: When the performance ended, the audience gave a thunderous ovation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧、⟦スタジアム→スタジアム：23905_sutajiamu⟧{中|じゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{沸|わ}き{上|あ}がった→沸き上がる：07263_wakiagaru⟧。
examples.english: The moment the player scored a goal, the entire stadium erupted in applause and cheers.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧ (clapping) and ⟦{喝采|かっさい}→喝采：08383_kassai⟧ (cheering, acclaim). The two components reinforce each other to express enthusiastic approval.

Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {拍手喝采|はくしゅかっさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.
